description: Dubnium is a synthetic chemical element with symbol Db and atomic number 105. It is highly radioactive, with the most stable known isotope, dubnium-268, having a half-life of about 16 hours. Dubnium does not occur naturally on Earth and is produced artificially.
characteristics: Dubnium is a member of group 5 in the 6d series of transition metals, placing it under vanadium, niobium, and tantalum. It should share most properties with the other group 5 elements, such as its valence electron configuration and a dominant +5 oxidation state, though with some anomalies due to relativistic effects. Limited investigation of dubnium chemistry has confirmed these theoretical predictions.
